purpose: Germany V9 first-pass tariff audit; exact contract-free station/EVSE pricing only, fail-closed where current direct pricing is not proven.

officialEvidence.facts: Official live payment page states spontaneous ad-hoc charging is available at all Norderstedt charging stations. SMS, web and m8mit-app direct payment are 0.6528 EUR/kWh AC and 0.7718 EUR/kWh DC; web/app use credit card or PayPal. Giro-e is available at DC fast chargers and is 0.66 EUR/kWh plus 0.35 EUR activation per session. The page separately identifies TuWatt+2Go RFID contract pricing, which is not used as ad-hoc pricing.

exactDirectTariffs.scope: DC fast chargers where Giro-e is installed

cpos.failClosedNotes: No TuWatt+2Go RFID subscriber price is substituted for ad-hoc. Giro-e is not generalized to AC because the official page says it is currently available at DC fast chargers.

officialEvidence.facts: Official live LSW AUTOSTROM page publishes 0.55 EUR/kWh AC and 0.65 EUR/kWh DC at LSW-operated charge points with no blocking fee, but presents these values as the LSW AUTOSTROM mobility-provider product. Partner locations use the price and conditions shown in eCharge+.

cpos.reasonDeferred: A current official public contract-free QR/card/ad-hoc price contract for all LSW-operated EVSEs was not found. The published 0.55/0.65 EUR/kWh values are tied to the LSW AUTOSTROM product and therefore cannot be promoted as universal ad-hoc pricing.
cpos.neededToComplete: Resolve an official LSW direct-payment/QR checkout or station-level public payload for representative LSW EVSE IDs, then map exact direct price and any payment-specific fees per EVSE without substituting the AUTOSTROM subscriber tariff.

officialEvidence.facts: Official FAQ current in 2026 confirms contract-free ad-hoc access at EWP EchtMobil chargers by scanning the QR code (Direct Payment) and paying by credit card. It reports 130 EWP public charge points as of 2026-03-01.

Official EWP EchtMobil app page displays 0.52 EUR/kWh AC and 0.62 EUR/kWh DC for EWP locations plus time fees, but labels the table as valid from 2024-05-01 and describes the app/contract product rather than explicitly tying those numbers to QR Direct Payment.

cpos.reasonDeferred: Current official documentation proves a QR/card ad-hoc path but does not publish a current numeric tariff explicitly bound to that Direct Payment path. The EchtMobil app tariff is not assumed to equal ad-hoc.
cpos.neededToComplete: Open a public EWP QR/Direct Payment checkout or obtain an official station-level tariff payload and bind its current numeric energy/time components to exact EWP EVSEs.
